title: Ruthless Loaded Glazed Donut Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Glazed Donut by Ruthless is a decadent take on a bakery classic, capturing the warm, doughy richness of a freshly baked donut coated in a layer of glistening sugar glaze. A subtle hint of cinnamon lingers in the background, adding a delicate spiced warmth that rounds out the sweetness without overpowering the flavour. Smooth, buttery, and deeply satisfying, this e-liquid delivers the indulgence of a sweet treat in every inhale. Part of the iconic Ruthless Shortfill range, Glazed Donut is blended with a 70VG/30PG ratio, optimised for thick, satisfying vapour clouds and a well-rounded flavour experience. Perfect for Sub-Ohm vape kits and high-powered devices, it comes in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, offering the flexibility to customise your nicotine strength. Ruthless is one of the longest-standing and most influential names in American e-liquids, known for crafting bold, unforgettable flavours that have defined the industry. Their expertly blended shortfills continue to set the benchmark for vapers seeking high-quality, complex profiles.
